title: [UK] TikTok Shop Partner Tiering Mechanism
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2026-08-20
html:
The TikTok Shop Partners('TSP') tiering system is designed to cultivate a robust ecosystem, set service benchmarks, and offer customized resources for TSP at various development stages—thereby guiding their growth path. In the tier system, TSP will be referred to the integration of all TSP/TAP/CAP. This Tiering Mechanism only applies to TikTok Shop Partners certified and operating in the UK market.

Last Update: 2026/08/12

Partner Tier Update

  • The original TSP, CAP, and TAP Partners will be consolidated under a unified name: TikTok Shop Partner（TSP ) categorized into two main types of services: Seller Services and Creator Services.
  • ++Seller Partner++ **** (Previously Known as TSP)
    • A Seller Partner's main function is servicing sellers (brands) on TikTok Shop through the means of shop operation management, short video production management, affiliate video management and live management.
  • ++Creator Partner++ (Previously Known as CAP)
    • A Creator Partner's main function is servicing and incubating creators for the TikTok Shop ecosystem.
  • ++Creator Matchmaking++++ ++++Tool++ (Previously Known as TAP)
    • Agency Partners utilize our TikTok Shop Partner Center to run partner campaigns that help execute and expedite matchmaking between merchants and creators, providing incremental opportunities and driving growth.

Rules for TSP Tiering

TSP Tiers

TSPs will be divided into 5 tiers from S1 to S5, corresponding to： S1 TSP->S2 Bronze TSP->S3 Silver TSP->S4 Gold TSP->S5 Platinum TSP The higher the partner's rating, the stronger its comprehensive promotion capabilities.

TSP Tier Calculation Rules

Main Evaluation Metrics

GMV - 70% Bonus scores - 30%
Creator Matchmaking TAP GMV * Bonus scores for TSP's service diversification and seller/creator growth ability
Creator Service CAP LIVE GMV
Seller Service TSP bind with SKM seller GMV
  • GMV Calculation Method

Example: A TSP's DAGMV last month is: TAP GMV: 10k Creator Service GMV: 15k Seller Service GMV: 20k The Total GMV in Ranking will be calculated as: ++10k+15k+20k=45k++

Tier Determination

Total 100% = 70% X 30%
Tier Tier Title Daily GMV Bonus scores
S5 Platinum 100K<GMV 0-18
S4 Gold 20K<GMV≤100K
S3 Silver 3K<GMV≤20K
S2 Bronze 500<GMV≤3K
S1 TSP 0≤GMV≤500

Rights and Benefits of Different TSP Tiers

  • The rights and benefits start from S1 TSP, the requirements for S1 are completion of training after joining and having GMV.
  • The platform grants TSPs different rights and benefits based on their tier levels and makes timely adjustments according to the rollout schedule of these benefits.
  • The rights and benefits available to TSPs at different tiers include, but are not limited to: access to honor awards, account/store protection and appeal, livestream support, exclusive event privileges, operation support, and more.

TSP Tier Update Schedule and Announcement Mechanism

Update Schedule

  • The TSP tier will be updated on the 3rd~5th day of each following month, and it will be calculated according to the performance data of the partner in the previous month.
  • There may be a delay in updating the tiering results, and the actual update will be based on the notification within the product.
  • The tiering result is automatically calculated by the system based on multiple performance indicators. It may also be partially adjusted manually based on the agency’s actual servicing of sellers/creators. Appeals are not supported at this stage.

Announcement Mechanism

After the tier update each month, the results will be announced through the following four main channels:

Official Seller/Affiliate Center Websites (https://seller.tiktok.com/uk)

TikTop Shop Partner tier information could be checked in the official seller / Affiliate Center Websites

✅ (launched) Shared on UK TTS’s Linkedin page

✅ (launched) Shared in the UK TTS agency Lark group

✅ (launched) Internally communicated across different industry teams within the UK TTS

Governance of TSP

General Rules for Seller & Creator Servive

  • During the period of agency's cooperation, serious violations occurred in e-commerce transactions and content, including but not limited to unauthorised streaming/recorded broadcasts/fake orders/illegal transactions, etc, will cause the termination of TSP on the platform.

For Seller Service:

Merchant Binding

  • After onboarding, agencies with no merchant binding for over 3 months will receive a warning email.
  • After onboarding, agencies with no merchant binding for over 6 months will be removed.

Client Complaint

  • Agencies receive more than 3 times client complaint in 1 month will receive a warning email.
  • After a formal warning has been issued with no subsequent improvement, and upon receiving 5 additional consecutive complaints, the partnership will be terminated.

For Creator Service:

  • Monitoring：There is a regular monitor of agencies for policy violations (e.g. pirated or low-quality content).
  • Warning：If risks are identified, agencies may receive a warning and enter a 7-day observation period to fix issues.
  • Enforcement：If no improvement or further violations occur, actions may be taken, including partnership removal.
  • Appeal：Agencies can submit appeals, which will be reviewed within 48 hours.

++*What happened after the removal process of TSP++

  1. General Rules:
  • Qualification removal: Removal of qualification in a specific country is irreversible. Can only add on qualifications in other countries;
  • Unable to add new service categories;
  • Services that have already been published under enabled categories will be taken down;
  • The corresponding service category menu in TTSPC will disappear;
  • Partners will be removed from the ranking list.
  1. Creator Service Specific:
  • Partners will automatically unbind from creators that were previously linked.
  1. Seller Service Specific:
  • Services published under the removed qualification will be marked as taken down;
  • Service subscriptions will be canceled.
